correctness.rationale: Each centered signed incidence coordinate equals (2 indegree − graph degree)/2, yielding the norm formula. Forbidden directed triangles give exactly the transition constraints; nonconstant spoke words forbid longer hub cycles, and precisely four cyclic rim words must be subtracted. A one-run bijection yields \(N_m(k,2)=\(m k(m-k)\)\). The k=0,m boundary and balanced mixed-spoke comparison yield the exact innermost shell and multiplicity for every \(m\ge4\). Independent full directed-orientation enumeration of m=4..9 checked 349440 assignments, 29466 acyclic orientations and 231 additional coefficient/boundary assertions; computations supplement the proof.
